objective: Prove the implication: for a class-4 edge, if zero-jump gadget counts are local up to a relabeling of degree-3 data (hypothesis L4, stated precisely), single edges have the linear-flow structure (LS) and the rank-witness ingredients (RW), then counting is #P-hard (Fourier dual with independent endpoint potentials, non-negative by linearity). Prove (LS) and (RW) by character arguments for free class 4 on (1,1), (0,1,1), (1,1,1) at d = 5 and their d = 10 relabelings, cite experiment CLASS4-PAIRS-20261028-001B-E001 as support for L4, and state precisely what a proof of L4 needs.
status: Closed: proved (P001). Theorem 7: if zero-jump gadget counts are local up to a relabeling of degree-3 data (L4), single edges have linear flows (LS) and the rank witness (RW), counting is #P-hard (Fourier dual with independent endpoint potentials). Corollary 7.1: (LS) and (RW) hold for six census algebras, hard if (L4) holds; (L4) is supported by experiment B, not proved.
title: Class-4 pair failures with linear flows are #P-hard if gadget counts are local up to relabeling
